infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: IntentFlow uses your location to remind you about tasks when you're near relevant locations like grocery stores or pharmacies.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: IntentFlow monitors your location in the background to proactively notify you about nearby tasks. This helps you remember to pick up items or complete errands while you're out.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: IntentFlow needs background location access to send you timely reminders when you approach locations relevant to your tasks.
